# Independent synthetic cases

`office/`: an actual ordinary-office encounter supports no automatic facility exception; expect a conditional likely-correct network route. `authorization/`: the MRI's code, provider and service date match an explicit authorization; expect a possible processing discrepancy, not guaranteed payment.

Each folder contains three one-page PDFs, editable source records, expected extraction JSON and outcome gates. All are fictional. Runtime must never read expected files. These cases are generated by `scripts/build_scenarios.py` using ReportLab and verified by backend pipeline tests with a test-only provider. Live extraction tests are still required.
